name: Chef Hand-off for MDL3
description: Lets Chef Shared Loader (and the mods made for it, such as HUDdle and Treasure Radar) run next to MDL3. MDL3 must have the higher priority (it wins the game's boot); this addon, started by MDL3, hands the game to Chef a few seconds after the game starts (the hand-off in Chef's own documentation, 'For other loaders'). Before that it takes the Chef mods that MDL3 has 'started' without Chef off package.loaded, so that Chef starts them properly, and it takes MDL3's own callbacks off the game's global table while Chef loads and puts them back behind Chef's, so that Chef's hang watchdog (Chef 1.4.0 and later) does not time MDL3 (0.2.3: MDL3 runs each addon in a sandbox of its own, and 0.2.1 and 0.2.2 only reached that sandbox). 0.2.4: an addon whose 'local chef = ...' comes after its first 16 KB (NarrowHUD 1.0.6) is recognised too. 0.2.6: the state mark is written and checked as soon as Chef has loaded, so a hand-off that worked no longer leaves 'attempt' behind (which made every later launch skip it). Does nothing when Chef is not installed or already running. Writes chef_handoff.log (the last launch's kept as chef_handoff.previous.log) into %APPDATA%\Arrowhead\Helldivers2. Needs MDL3 and Chef Shared Loader 1.2.0 or newer (tested in the game with 1.4.1, 1.5.1 and 1.5.3), with MDL3 at a higher priority than Chef. Give this mod the lowest priority: MDL3 3.0.0-dev.33 was seen to look at only the first 512 patch files.
